company.what_they_do: Farede (full legal name: Farede Injetados Plásticos e Ferramentaria Ltda) is a Brazilian manufacturer specializing in plastic injection molding and mold tooling. Founded in 1994 and headquartered in Tatuapé, São Paulo (SP), they develop custom molds and inject thermoplastic parts using high-technology equipment (injectors ranging 80–380 tons of closing force, including vertical and two-color injection). They work across several market segments: footwear, orthopedic, sports/extreme sports, civil construction, toys, and accessories. They also hold official licenses for sports brands Topper, Rainha, and SpoArt, and produce sports accessories such as elastic and neoprene protective gear (ankle, wrist, knee protectors, shin guards, gloves) and motorcyclist accessories. Services include product development, custom mold creation, thermoplastic injection, and mold maintenance/modification/reform.
